shipped_module_contract.compose: compose_task(theme, stressors, hazards, governance_mode, seed, out_dir)
shipped_module_contract.canonical_ids: S01_name -> S01 and H01_name -> H01 via the first underscore token

jobs.factory_load_retry: pipelines/ingest_feed.py retry, only when H12 is active

shipped_module_contract.load_calls_fold: ingest_feed.load starts fold_ledger.py fold in a subprocess after the raw commit
shipped_module_contract.partial_fix: solution/partial_fix.py repairs t0 with the oracle modules, then copies solution/partial/ over the workspace
shipped_module_contract.execution_tables: spec.execution_tables and result['t0_tables'] are the relations actually written, including the checkpoint
shipped_module_contract.future_tables: spec.future_tables and result['future_tables'] are raw, fact, and handoff for R1-R4
shipped_module_contract.publication_table: result['publication_table'] is the handoff that was written
shipped_module_contract.declared_tables: spec.tables lists native contract surfaces; execution_tables binds the physical relations written by the three modules
shipped_module_contract.physical_tables: result['physical_tables'] is the binding baked into the three modules
shipped_module_contract.fallback: If a built theme already owns the contract table with a different column set, execution binds physical_tables and does not drop the native table. Grade execution_tables in that case.
shipped_module_contract.null_handoff: A null handoff_table, close_window_table, or corrections_table executes on the physical publication/close/corrections relations bound in execution_tables.
shipped_module_contract.grain_keys: Physical feed columns stay event_id, business_id, business_day, entity_id, amount_cents, version. Theme grain is spec.domain_grain_keys and spec.domain.
shipped_module_contract.breadcrumbs: Active H01-H14 clues are under workspace/docs/ or var/logs/. R1-R4 payloads stay in build/factory_future.
